title: Public adopter conformance checks
summary: Add repeatable checks against pinned project fixtures for fresh adoption, populated upgrades, and catalog navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Cover a blank catalog, a populated manual catalog, and a catalog with directed relationships.
Show preservation of existing records, resolvable references, and deterministic generated output.

evidence.claim: README-HQ provides a public, populated branch-first catalog fixture.
Veraphify provides a larger, related catalog fixture.
